result.title: RouteDRAG: Learning to Route and Control Agentic Execution for Multimodal Document RAG
result.comment: Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG
result.summary: Web-based applications increasingly rely on understanding long multimodal documents, where answering questions often requires combining information across pages, tables, and figures. Agentic retrieval-augmented generation addresses these tasks through iterative retrieval and reasoning. However, Agentic execution is not always necessary, introducing additional computation and potentially incorrect answers. Our empirical analysis reveals that Agentic execution provides query-dependent benefits, while additional operations may improve, preserve, or degrade answer accuracy. These findings motivate controlling both Agent invocation and subsequent execution. To address these challenges, we propose RouteDRAG, a learning-based framework comprising four components. Unified Document Index organizes multimodal content into a graph-backed index and derives query representations from initial retrieval. Adaptive Path Routing preserves exact answering and predicts the relative benefit of Agent over shorter execution paths. Dynamic Agent Execution maintains an evolving workspace and refines Planner proposals to control tool use and termination. Sequential Policy Learning first trains operation control from observed outcomes and then trains path routing using the resulting Agent's performance. Across two benchmarks, RouteDRAG achieves an average accuracy improvement of 3.47 percentage points over shorter-path-only execution while assigning only 79.3% of queries to Agent. Notably, it also surpasses uniform Agent execution on both benchmarks while requiring fewer answering calls. Our code is now available at https://github.com/Ereshkigal1/RouteDRAG.

AI.brief_summary: 针对多模态长文档 RAG，实证发现 agentic 迭代检索的收益依查询而异、额外操作甚至可能降低准确率，据此提出 RouteDRAG：用图结构文档索引与查询表示、路径路由预测 Agent 相对短路径的增益，并以动态工作区和序贯策略学习控制工具调用与终止。
AI.relevance_reason: 把「是否值得多步推理、何时停止」显式建模为依查询预测的收益—成本决策，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益归因和停止决策直接相关；但其推理发生在检索与工具调用层面而非 latent 状态，路由信号能否迁移到 latent 步数分配可供核查。
